typecheck-tests.note: tsconfig.json covers src/ alone, and vitest runs a test without type-checking it, so this is what type-checks test/.

rule-tests.note: Each door rule in rules/ has a fixture in rule-tests/ proving it fires; record snapshots with `pnpm exec ast-grep test -U`. Fixtures can't see paths, so test/integration/layout.test.ts checks where each door and ring applies by scanning a real tree.
